privacyStep.title: Privacy & session
privacyStep.description: Your safety and privacy come first. EXIT runs completely in your browser's temporary memory.

deviceSafetyStep.title: Device & communication safety

deviceSafetyStep.q1Desc: If someone else checks your lock screen or phone, notifications might be seen.

deviceSafetyStep.q2Desc: Such as knowing your passcode, using your tablet, or looking at your browser history.

deviceSafetyStep.q3Desc: Such as shared Apple/Google Family accounts, find-my-device, or shared email logins.
deviceSafetyStep.quietModeAutoNoticeDesc: Because your device or accounts may be accessed by others, Quiet Mode has been enabled to prevent alerts and keep the interface discreet.

actions.title: Suggested Preparation Actions
actions.description: These deterministic actions are generated based on your selected needs and device safety assessment. You can complete, edit, or dismiss any action.

commSafeChannel.title: Establish a discreet communication method
commSafeChannel.description: Use private browser tabs, clear call histories, or communicate from a separate safe device outside the home.
commSafeChannel.reason: Triggered because your device or notifications may be accessed by others.

commTrustedContact.title: Identify one trusted contact if safe
commTrustedContact.description: Choose a trusted friend or support worker who does not communicate with the person causing concern.
commTrustedContact.reason: Triggered because having a discreet point of contact provides reliable safety continuity.

digitalAuditLogins.title: Audit shared accounts and location sharing
digitalAuditLogins.description: Check Find My Device, Google Family Link, shared cloud backups, and remove unknown paired devices if safe to do so.
digitalAuditLogins.reason: Triggered because shared accounts or active location tracking were indicated.

digitalLocationCheck.title: Review app permissions and Bluetooth tracking
digitalLocationCheck.description: Turn off location permissions for non-essential apps and check for Bluetooth trackers or unfamiliar connected accessories.
digitalLocationCheck.reason: Triggered to prevent unnoticed physical movement tracking.

docsChecklist.title: Create an essential documents checklist
docsChecklist.description: List all critical documents: Aadhaar/National ID, passport, birth certificates, marriage certificate, property papers, and bank passbooks.
docsChecklist.reason: Triggered because essential documents were selected as a planning need.

docsSecureStorage.title: Store digital copies in a confidential location
docsSecureStorage.description: Keep digital scans in a new private cloud account or leave physical copies with a trusted legal aid representative.
docsSecureStorage.reason: Triggered to ensure document availability if originals cannot be accessed.

moneyEmergencyCash.title: Build a confidential emergency cash reserve
moneyEmergencyCash.description: Keep a small amount of physical cash in a secure, accessible place outside joint bank visibility.
moneyEmergencyCash.reason: Triggered because money and emergency independence were selected.

moneyIndependentBank.title: Open a sole-name bank account
moneyIndependentBank.description: Open a bank account in your name only with digital statements sent to a secure, unshared email address.
moneyIndependentBank.reason: Triggered to secure future salary and emergency fund access.

housingTemporaryOptions.title: Explore verified temporary accommodation
housingTemporaryOptions.description: Review verified crisis shelters, short-stay homes, or trusted temporary living arrangements.
housingTemporaryOptions.reason: Triggered because housing was selected as an active planning need.

housingSafeRoute.title: Plan safe travel and transportation
housingSafeRoute.description: Identify public transport schedules, reliable taxi options, or safe transit points.
housingSafeRoute.reason: Triggered to avoid transport bottlenecks during relocation.

childrenEssentialsPack.title: Prepare dependent essentials bag
childrenEssentialsPack.description: Pack immunization cards, birth certificates, school records, spare clothing, and comforting items for children.
childrenEssentialsPack.reason: Triggered because children/dependents were selected in your plan.

childrenContinuityPlan.title: Plan school and healthcare continuity
childrenContinuityPlan.description: Note down paediatrician contacts and understand local school transfer protocols in your destination region.
childrenContinuityPlan.reason: Triggered to ensure child wellness and routine stability.

healthPrescriptionsPack.title: Secure 30-day medication and medical records
healthPrescriptionsPack.description: Obtain refills for critical prescriptions and keep copies of medical history in a safe place.
healthPrescriptionsPack.reason: Triggered because healthcare and medical needs were selected.

healthConfidentialPathway.title: Identify a confidential healthcare clinic
healthConfidentialPathway.description: Find verified public or NGO healthcare providers that do not require emergency family contact disclosure.
healthConfidentialPathway.reason: Triggered to ensure private, judgment-free medical care access.

legalProtectionOrders.title: Review protection order pathways
legalProtectionOrders.description: Learn about statutory protection orders, residence orders, and immediate civil injunctions.
legalProtectionOrders.reason: Triggered because legal support was selected as a planning need.

legalFreeCounsel.title: Connect with verified legal aid counsel
legalFreeCounsel.description: Consult state legal services authorities or specialized legal aid NGOs for free, confidential counsel.
legalFreeCounsel.reason: Triggered to provide accessible legal representation without financial strain.

workDirectDepositPrivacy.title: Route employment earnings to a private account
workDirectDepositPrivacy.description: Update payroll direct deposit details with your employer to point to your unshared account.
workDirectDepositPrivacy.reason: Triggered because work and livelihood continuity were selected.

workDiscretionChecklist.title: Request workplace privacy discretion
workDiscretionChecklist.description: Speak with trusted HR or management to remove public directory listings and restrict visitor access.
workDiscretionChecklist.reason: Triggered to maintain workplace safety and confidentiality.

consent.title: Consent Gateway & Data Airlock
consent.subtitle: You control whether voluntary, de-identified data is shared with the LIVEGENDER service observatory. Default is 100% private.
consent.airlockDescription: EXIT uses a strict one-way airlock to ensure individual cases, identities, exact locations, and evidence files can NEVER enter institutional observatory data.
consent.allowedFieldsSub: Choose only what you are comfortable sharing for aggregate service planning.
consent.fieldHarmCategoryDesc: General category only (e.g., Financial control, Digital tracking).
consent.fieldBroadRegionDesc: State or district level only. Never exact GPS, address, or shelter coordinate.
consent.fieldServiceNeedDesc: Types of support sought (e.g., Legal aid, Transition shelter).
consent.forbiddenFieldsSub: The airlock hard-rejects the following data. They never reach the observatory.
consent.forbidden1: No real names, phone numbers, email addresses, or physical addresses.
consent.forbidden2: No exact GPS coordinates, travel routes, workplace, or shelter locations.
consent.forbidden3: No evidence files, screenshots, voice notes, or raw narrative text.
consent.forbidden4: No IP addresses, device IDs, or browser fingerprints.
consent.forbidden5: No data published if fewer than 20 independent contributions exist (k ≥ 20 threshold).
consent.privateSuccess: All consent withdrawn. Session returned to 100% private default.

observatory.title: LIVEGENDER — Institutional Observatory
observatory.subtitle: Aggregated, de-identified insights on gender-based harm and support needs for civil society and service providers.
observatory.syntheticWarningText: All records shown in this dashboard are synthetic demonstration fixtures for hackathon evaluation. No real survivor case data or personal information is stored or transmitted.
observatory.stage1Detail: Hard-rejects any record containing linkable identifiers (names, IDs, phone, GPS, raw plan text, vault files). ({{rejected}} rejected)
observatory.stage2Detail: Removes all non-whitelisted metadata, device headers, and timestamps.
observatory.stage3Detail: Buckets exact event times into broad calendar quarters (e.g., Q3 2026).
observatory.stage4Detail: Coarsens local coordinates and districts into broad multi-state regions.
observatory.stage5Detail: Validates all fields against the closed, approved harm and service taxonomy.
observatory.stage6Detail: Enforces cell-level anonymity: any category combination with fewer than {{kThreshold}} contributions is completely suppressed. ({{suppressed}} suppressed)
observatory.stage7Detail: Releases safe aggregate cell counts to the dashboard. No individual rows exist. ({{cells}} cells, {{released}} contributions released)
observatory.kThresholdExplanation: Cells with fewer than {{k}} contributions are entirely withheld from release to prevent small-cell re-identification.
observatory.differentialPrivacyNote: Prototype privacy protection using de-identification, generalization, aggregation and k-threshold suppression.
observatory.chartDisclaimer: Aggregates are derived from synthetic contributions passing the k ≥ 20 airlock threshold.
observatory.noDataReleased: No aggregate cells met the k ≥ {{k}} privacy threshold.
observatory.tableNote: All rows represent aggregated cells meeting the k ≥ {{k}} threshold. No individual-level records are accessible.
observatory.neverSeesTitle: What LIVEGENDER Never Receives or Stores

observatory.neverSees2: Raw EXIT Plan contents, selected checklists, or custom action notes
observatory.neverSees3: AegisVault evidence files, images, recordings, or plainhashes

observatory.neverSees5: Individual contribution rows or linkable transaction histories
observatory.neverSees6: Predictive danger scores, risk ratings, or unsafe-area heatmaps

digitalSafety.title: Digital Safety Checkup
digitalSafety.subtitle: A private review of digital settings that can affect your safety and control.
digitalSafety.privacyNoticeText: This checkup uses your answers only. EXIT does not scan your device, inspect files, or access your accounts.

labels.noFlaggedItems: No concerns flagged across your completed answers.

deviceShared.title: Is this device shared with someone else?
deviceShared.desc: Such as a family tablet, shared home computer, or partner having device passcode access.
deviceShared.whyMatters: Shared devices may allow others to view active apps, browsing history, and downloaded files.
deviceShared.action: Use private tabs, create a separate user profile, or access sensitive planning on an unshared device.

deviceLockNotifications.title: Are sensitive notifications visible on the lock screen?
deviceLockNotifications.desc: Message previews or verification codes displaying when the screen is locked.
deviceLockNotifications.whyMatters: Lock-screen previews can be read without unlocking your phone.
deviceLockNotifications.action: Change notification settings to 'Hide sensitive content' or 'Don't show notification content' on lock screen.

deviceUnfamiliarApps.title: Are there unfamiliar apps with sensitive permissions?
deviceUnfamiliarApps.desc: Apps you do not remember installing that have location, microphone, camera, or SMS permissions.
deviceUnfamiliarApps.whyMatters: Unfamiliar apps with elevated permissions can be used for monitoring or location tracking.
deviceUnfamiliarApps.action: Review installed applications in system settings and uninstall or revoke permissions for unverified apps.

accountsUnfamiliar.title: Is an unfamiliar account signed in on your device?
accountsUnfamiliar.desc: Secondary Google, Apple ID, Microsoft, or email accounts linked to your apps.
accountsUnfamiliar.whyMatters: Linked secondary accounts can sync browsing history, photos, location, and backup copies.
accountsUnfamiliar.action: Check system Settings > Accounts, remove unfamiliar accounts, and ensure only your personal account is signed in.

accountsRecovery.title: Is account recovery controlled exclusively by you?
accountsRecovery.desc: Recovery email addresses and phone numbers attached to your primary accounts.
accountsRecovery.whyMatters: If someone else controls your recovery email or phone, they can reset your passwords at any time.
accountsRecovery.action: Verify and update recovery email and phone numbers in your Google/Apple/email security settings.

accountsSessions.title: Are there unknown active sessions on your primary accounts?
accountsSessions.desc: Logged-in devices or locations listed in your Google, Apple, or email security dashboards.
accountsSessions.whyMatters: Old or unrecognized logged-in sessions allow continuous remote access to messages and cloud files.
accountsSessions.action: Go to your account security center, review all active devices, and click 'Sign out of all other sessions'.

locationLiveShared.title: Is live location shared with someone you do not want to have it?
locationLiveShared.desc: Active location sharing in Google Maps, Apple Find My, WhatsApp, or carrier family plans.
locationLiveShared.whyMatters: Continuous location sharing reveals exact physical whereabouts and travel routes in real time.
locationLiveShared.action: Open Google Maps and Apple Find My settings, review the 'Location Sharing' list, and stop sharing.

locationSharedAccounts.title: Are location-sharing services connected to shared accounts?
locationSharedAccounts.desc: Find My Device or Google Family Link linked to an account shared with a family member or partner.
locationSharedAccounts.whyMatters: Shared accounts enable device tracking even when standalone app location sharing is disabled.
locationSharedAccounts.action: Disassociate from shared family organizer accounts or set up an independent account for private travel.

commPreviews.title: Could message previews appear on the lock screen?
commPreviews.desc: WhatsApp, SMS, or Telegram alerts popping up with sender names or message content.
commPreviews.whyMatters: Discreet messages from support services or friends can be seen by anyone near your phone.
commPreviews.action: Disable message previews inside messaging apps (e.g., WhatsApp > Settings > Notifications > Show Preview: Off).

commSharedChannel.title: Is communication happening through a shared device or account?
commSharedChannel.desc: Using a shared tablet, shared cellular plan call logs, or mutual email inbox for planning.
commSharedChannel.whyMatters: Itemized carrier bills and shared inboxes create permanent records visible to account owners.
commSharedChannel.action: Switch to private secure channels, delete individual call records, or communicate from a trusted safe device.

socialSessions.title: Are there unfamiliar active sessions on your social accounts?
socialSessions.desc: Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, or LinkedIn logged into devices you do not recognize.
socialSessions.whyMatters: Active social logins allow silent reading of direct messages and location check-ins.
socialSessions.action: Navigate to Privacy & Security in each social app, view active logins, and log out of all unknown devices.

socialRecovery.title: Can another person access recovery methods for your social accounts?
socialRecovery.desc: Shared email inboxes, old family phone numbers, or linked mutual accounts.
socialRecovery.whyMatters: Account takeover can happen easily if password reset links arrive on accessible devices.
socialRecovery.action: Update two-factor authentication (2FA) to an authenticator app rather than shared SMS.

socialPrivacy.title: Are your social account privacy settings configured appropriately?
socialPrivacy.desc: Profiles set to private, story location tags disabled, and friend lists hidden.
socialPrivacy.whyMatters: Public posts, tagged photos, and mutual friend interactions can expose location and routine.
socialPrivacy.action: Set profile visibility to Private, disable tagging without approval, and hide your friend lists.

cloudSharedFolders.title: Are shared folders or cloud accounts accessible by someone else?
cloudSharedFolders.desc: Google Drive, iCloud Family Sharing, OneDrive, or Dropbox folders with shared edit/view rights.
cloudSharedFolders.whyMatters: Uploading documents or photos to shared cloud folders makes them immediately visible to co-owners.
cloudSharedFolders.action: Audit shared folders, move private safety files to a separate unshared account, and remove shared links.

cloudBackups.title: Are device or photo backups connected to accounts you do not control?
cloudBackups.desc: Automatic Google Photos or iCloud photo stream syncing to an unshared or partner-managed account.
cloudBackups.whyMatters: Screenshots and saved documents may automatically sync into someone else's photo library.
cloudBackups.action: Turn off automatic cloud photo backup or ensure backups upload exclusively to your private account.

recoveryEmail.title: Do you exclusively control your recovery email?
recoveryEmail.desc: You are the only person who knows the password and receives alerts for the recovery email address.
recoveryEmail.whyMatters: A recovery email is the master key to regaining or seizing control of an online identity.
recoveryEmail.action: Create a new, dedicated private recovery email account and attach it to your key profiles.

recoveryPhone.title: Do you exclusively control your recovery phone number?
recoveryPhone.desc: SMS reset codes arrive on a SIM card and phone that only you can access.
recoveryPhone.whyMatters: SIM swapping or access to physical notification screens allows unauthorized account takeovers.
recoveryPhone.action: Ensure your recovery phone is not a shared landline or family plan SIM managed by another person.

recoveryTrustedDevices.title: Are all trusted devices and authentication sessions under your control?
recoveryTrustedDevices.desc: Apple ID 2FA prompt devices, Google Prompt phones, and hardware security keys.
recoveryTrustedDevices.whyMatters: Prompt-based 2FA requests can be approved from any registered trusted device.
recoveryTrustedDevices.action: Review trusted devices in your Apple/Google security center and delete any old, lost, or shared hardware.
